# Generated folder: do not edit by hand

This folder is generated by `scripts/build-standalone.py` from the sources below. Edit the sources, then run
`python3 scripts/build-standalone.py`; a test runs `python3 scripts/build-standalone.py --check` and fails when this
folder is out of date.

- Skill: `plugins/linkedin/skills/linkedin-job-signals`, copied as it is.
- Engine: only these files of `plugins/linkedin/skills/linkedin`:
- `scripts/job_signals.py`
- `scripts/li_common.py`
- `scripts/search_jobs.js`
- `references/job_signal_presets.json`
- `references/job_endpoints.md`
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: built from the `linkedin-job-signals` entry in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.

The whitelist and the other settings are in `scripts/standalone.json`.
